GTA 6 Hidden Locations

Concealed labs, safes, bunkers and other hidden places reported by published guides.

25 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Trophy-room bunkerA closed entrance is not the only way in. Submerged photo-clue carFollow the photograph toward the water. Junkyard photo-clue carSearch behind the obvious scrap. Water-tower trailer clueA photograph points beyond a water tower. La Perle concealed labLook for signs of unusual laundry work. Decor District garage labA commercial car park hides more than stock. Kingpin Bowling hidden safeThe clue is not in the same building. The Surfside Drive Kill RoomOne garage in southwest Key Lento is lined with plastic, and not for painting. President Russo's BunkersA downtown memorial hides the way into a deposed president's boltholes. The Hunt on Hyde IslandWalk Hyde Island alone for long enough and the island starts hunting back. The Ghost Ship of St. Lucia LighthouseThe lighthouse keepers never really left, and neither did their ship. The Fog at the Marbelle HotelA Crosstown hotel with a back way in, a strange rooftop, and fog that feels borrowed from another game. SOS IslandA speck of land far out in the bay has been waiting for a rescue that never came. The Crashed Glider of Bobcat BightA pilot came down in the trees off North Mariana County and left something behind. The KrakenSomething enormous grips a sunken ship on the seabed south of Vice City. Burg Industries Facility 1A yellow platform in open water marks where a billionaire's scientists went quiet. Burg Industries Facility 3 (Key Lento)Another of Burg's yellow platforms floats in the open sea east of Key Lento. The Burg Research Habitat off Little Hardin IslandA big yellow buoy off Little Hardin Island is not marking a shipping lane. Monument of Leonidan SupremacyFour horses and a sphere in Manifest Canyon are broadcasting something nobody has decoded. The Mount Kalaga Fire Tower ShedA locked shed below a mountain fire tower keeps a logbook with a disturbing sketch. Underground Alien Lab (Southpoint Airfield)The UFO abduction is not the end of the chain — it is the directions to somewhere stranger. Dog IslandA beach that only a dog can take you to. Teddy Bear WarehouseA warehouse full of teddy bears, dead gangsters and unguarded money — reportedly. Mile Zero Air Station (Goose Key)A naval airfield in the Keys where the fence line is worth six stars. Enterable Interiors — The Full CountHow much of Leonida can you actually walk into? Two databases counted.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
